Slow-roasted tomato and white bean soup with crispy garlic croutons

Edit

A thick, smoky soup that tastes like it took all day. Most of the time is hands-off in the oven, and the croutons can be made while the tomatoes roast.

Prep
20 min
Cook
1 hr 30 min
Total
1 hr 50 min
Serves
6 servings
Calories
410 kcal
Cuisine
Italian
freezer-friendly make-ahead soup vegetarian winter

Source: recipes.example.com/soups/slow-roasted-tomato-and-white-bea…

Ingredients

  • 1.5 kg ripe plum tomatoes, halved
  • 1 head garlic, cloves separated and peeled
  • 3 tbsp olive oil, plus more for drizzling
  • 2 × 400 g tins cannellini beans, drained and rinsed
  • 750 ml vegetable stock
  • 1 tsp smoked paprika
  • Salt and freshly ground black pepper
  • 4 thick slices day-old sourdough, torn into bite-sized pieces
  • A small handful of basil leaves, to serve

Method

  1. Heat the oven to 160°C (140°C fan). Spread the tomatoes cut-side up on a large roasting tray with half the garlic, drizzle with 2 tbsp oil, season generously, and roast for 1 hour 15 minutes until collapsed and caramelised at the edges.
  2. Scrape everything into a large pan, add the beans, stock and paprika, and simmer for 15 minutes.
  3. Meanwhile, toss the bread with the remaining oil and garlic (finely sliced) and bake for 10–12 minutes until golden.
  4. Blend half the soup until smooth, stir it back in, and adjust the seasoning.
  5. Serve topped with croutons, basil and a final drizzle of oil.
